Question 4
?

If f(x)=sin⁡(ex), find (f−1)′(x) as a function of f−1(x).

a
e−f−1(x)cos⁡(ef−1(x))
b
e−f−1(x)sec⁡(ef−1(x))
c
ef−1(x)csc⁡(ef−1(x))
d
ef−1(x)cos⁡(ef−1(x))
e
ef−1(x)sec⁡(e−f−1(x))
